pass: Final Adversarial Composition, Lifecycle Integrity & Recovery Verification

FINAL-INV-01.name: Failure Cannot Fragment One Logical Transaction
FINAL-INV-01.definition: For one canonical financial transaction, partial success across feature state, graph state, persistence, inference, alerting, and recovery must not produce mutually contradictory business identities.

FINAL-INV-02.name: Tenant Context Cannot Be Rebound During Recovery
FINAL-INV-02.definition: A retry, replay, cache restoration, stale response, or recovery action must never cause an object originally belonging to Tenant A to become visible or mutable under Tenant B.
FINAL-INV-02.boundary: IdempotencyService, FeatureStoreService, CaseRepository, and API Tenant Isolation
FINAL-INV-02.oracle: Tuple (tenant_id, object_type, canonical_object_id) strictly partitioned; cross-tenant retry blocked with 403 or isolated B state

FINAL-INV-03.name: Decision Evidence Is Version-Bound
FINAL-INV-03.definition: A decision produced by model version V1 must not silently acquire V2 model identity, V2 score, V2 explanation, or another transaction's evidence merely because V2 becomes active while asynchronous work is completing.
FINAL-INV-03.oracle: T bound to V1 metadata/score; U bound to V2; historical query for T returns V1 even when active champion is V2

FINAL-INV-04.name: Untrusted Persisted or Replayed State Fails Safely
FINAL-INV-04.definition: Malformed, conflicting, non-finite, stale, or identity-inconsistent state crossing an authoritative boundary must not silently become valid application state.
FINAL-INV-04.boundary: FastAPI request schemas, IdempotencyService payload hash, and CaseManagementService CAS
FINAL-INV-04.oracle: Payload mismatch yields HTTP 409; non-finite numeric state rejected/quarantined; stale version yields 409/Precondition Failed

FINAL-INV-05.name: Recovery Preserves Meaning, Not Just Availability
FINAL-INV-05.definition: After failure and recovery, the system must return to a state semantically equivalent to a valid execution. Service availability alone is insufficient.
FINAL-INV-05.boundary: Lifecycle state machine, case resolution, and timeline integrity
FINAL-INV-05.oracle: Metamorphic equivalence: LogicalState(clean) == LogicalState(recovered) for durable business objects

FINAL-INV-06.name: Authoritative History Remains Internally Consistent
FINAL-INV-06.definition: After adversarial lifecycle execution, transaction identity, model decision, alert identity, case history, human disposition, and audit trail must describe one coherent history.
FINAL-INV-06.boundary: Immutable timeline hash chain and CaseEvent audit sequence
FINAL-INV-06.oracle: verify_timeline() == True; human disposition is CLOSED_CONFIRMED without altering original model prediction history

FINAL-INV-07.name: No Silent Security Downgrade Appears During Recovery
FINAL-INV-07.definition: Recovery/retry logic must not bypass tenant isolation, privacy enforcement, robust aggregation requirements, authorization, case concurrency protection, or input validation simply because the system is recovering from another fault.
FINAL-INV-07.boundary: Four-Eyes dual control enforcement, ABAC/RBAC tenant gates, and Differential Privacy accountant
FINAL-INV-07.oracle: Four-Eyes signatures strictly required; self-approval prohibited; privacy limits enforced during recovery
